topic: Phone and CW operating (G2A, G2C; 23 pool questions)

questions.question: Which mode is most commonly used for voice communications on frequencies of 14 MHz or higher?
Which mode is most commonly used for voice communications on the 160-, 75-, and 40-meter bands?
Which mode is most commonly used for SSB voice communications in the VHF and UHF bands?
Which mode is most commonly used for voice communications on the 17- and 12-meter bands?
Which mode of voice communication is most commonly used on the HF amateur bands?
Which of the following is an advantage of using single sideband, as compared to other analog voice modes on the HF amateur bands?

choices.B: Less subject to interference from atmospheric static crashes
choices.C: Ease of tuning on receive and immunity to impulse noise
choices.D: Less bandwidth used and greater power efficiency

questions.answer: Less bandwidth used and greater power efficiency

questions.question: Which of the following statements is true of single sideband (SSB)?

choices.A: Only one sideband and the carrier are transmitted; the other sideband is suppressed
choices.B: Only one sideband is transmitted; the other sideband and carrier are suppressed
choices.C: SSB is the only voice mode authorized on the 20-, 15-, and 10-meter amateur bands
choices.D: SSB is the only voice mode authorized on the 160-, 75-, and 40-meter amateur bands

questions.answer: Only one sideband is transmitted; the other sideband and carrier are suppressed

questions.question: What is the recommended way to break into a phone contact?

choices.A: Say “QRZ” several times, followed by your call sign
choices.D: Say “CQ” followed by the call sign of either station

questions.question: Why do most amateur stations use lower sideband on the 160-, 75-, and 40-meter bands?

choices.A: Lower sideband is more efficient than upper sideband at these frequencies
choices.B: Lower sideband is the only sideband legal on these frequency bands
choices.C: Because it is fully compatible with an AM detector
choices.D: It is commonly accepted amateur practice

questions.answer: It is commonly accepted amateur practice

questions.question: Which of the following statements is true of VOX operation versus PTT operation?

choices.A: The received signal is more natural sounding

questions.question: Generally, who should respond to a station in the contiguous 48 states calling “CQ DX”?

choices.A: Any caller is welcome to respond
choices.C: Any stations outside the lower 48 states

questions.answer: Any stations outside the lower 48 states

questions.question: What control is typically adjusted for proper ALC setting on a single sideband transceiver?
Which of the following describes full break-in CW operation (QSK)?

choices.A: Breaking stations send the Morse code prosign “BK”
choices.B: Automatic keyers, instead of hand keys, are used to send Morse code
choices.C: An operator must activate a manual send/receive switch before and after every transmission
choices.D: Transmitting stations can receive between code characters and elements

questions.answer: Transmitting stations can receive between code characters and elements

questions.question: What should you do if a CW station sends “QRS?”
What does it mean when a CW operator sends “KN” at the end of a transmission?

choices.C: Listening only for a specific station or stations

questions.answer: Listening only for a specific station or stations

questions.question: What does the Q signal “QRL?” mean?

choices.B: “Are you operating full break-in?” or “Can you operate full break-in?”
choices.C: “Are you listening only for a specific station?”
choices.D: “Are you busy?” or “Is this frequency in use?”

questions.answer: “Are you busy?” or “Is this frequency in use?”

questions.question: What is the best speed to use when answering a CQ in Morse code?

choices.A: The fastest speed at which you are comfortable copying, but no slower than the CQ
choices.B: The fastest speed at which you are comfortable copying, but no faster than the CQ
choices.C: At the standard calling speed of 10 wpm
choices.D: At the standard calling speed of 5 wpm

questions.answer: The fastest speed at which you are comfortable copying, but no faster than the CQ

questions.question: What does the term “zero beat” mean in CW operation?

choices.A: Matching the speed of the transmitting station
choices.B: Operating split to avoid interference on frequency
choices.D: Matching the transmit frequency to the frequency of a received signal

questions.answer: Matching the transmit frequency to the frequency of a received signal

questions.question: When sending CW, what does a “C” mean when added to the RST report?

choices.B: Report was read from an S meter rather than estimated

questions.question: What prosign is sent to indicate the end of a formal message when using CW?
What does the Q signal “QSL” mean?

choices.B: We have already confirmed the contact

questions.question: What does the Q signal “QRN” mean?
What does the Q signal “QRV” mean?

choices.B: There is interference on the frequency
choices.C: I am quitting for the day
